intro.text: A city on Roshar with one of the ten Oathgates linked to Urithiru.
A city west of the Purelake in central Babatharnam, with one of the ten Oathgates linked to Urithiru.

items.text: Before the battle for Thaylen City, Dalinar feared that the armies of Iri and Rira, now allied with the Voidbringers, might have seized Panatham and its Oathgate.
